qrModal.guideTip1Desc: Scan using the recommended .local domain. No matter which Wi-Fi your Mac switches to, .local automatically resolves to the new IP.
qrModal.guideTip2Desc: When Wi-Fi switches on Mac, a desktop banner pops up showing current LAN IP and access URL immediately.
qrModal.guideTip3Desc: Configure your Bark URL in Settings, and your phone will receive instant push notifications with new clickable URLs when Mac Wi-Fi switches.

downloadModal.customDirGuideTitle: Want to choose a custom save folder?
downloadModal.customDirGuideDesc: Due to browser security policies, web pages cannot directly access local disks over local HTTP. To choose where to save each file, enable your browser's prompt setting:
downloadModal.guideChromeEdge: Chrome / Edge: Settings → Downloads → Turn on "Ask where to save each file before downloading"
downloadModal.guideFirefox: Firefox: Settings → General → Downloads → Turn on "Always ask you where to save files"
downloadModal.guideResult: After enabling, clicking "Confirm Download" will open the native Save As dialog to let you choose any folder.
downloadModal.guideExpand: How to choose a custom save directory
downloadModal.macSystemFilesTip: Note: Due to macOS and Chromium security restrictions, selecting the root "Downloads" or "Desktop" folder directly is blocked by browser ("contains system files"). To save inside Downloads, create a new subfolder and select it; or simply use "System Default".

downloadModal.completedSubtitle: File has been successfully saved to your local device
downloadModal.completedDefaultHintMac: Tip: You can find the file in Finder → Downloads or press ⌥⌘L.
downloadModal.completedDefaultHintWin: Tip: You can find the file in This PC → Downloads.
downloadModal.completedDefaultHintGeneric: Tip: You can find the file in your system's Downloads folder or browser downloads.
